props.label: Star-facing window and helm consoles
props.note: Blue-green displays follow the curve of the broad upper bridge window. This console connects to the Navigation Log network. Open it to recover cached data, read character dossiers, or transfer credits.

description: The ship's bridge has a wide metal floor marked with a compass-like star at the centre. The captain's chair stands on a raised platform facing a curved bank of blue-green control screens and a broad star-facing window. Smaller helm chairs sit beneath the surrounding displays. On the upper left, a cylindrical blue transport chamber glows beside the wall. A red-upholstered lounge occupies the lower-left corner, while a rectangular briefing table with a luminous blue surface and several chairs sits on the right. Warm strip lights and banners soften the industrial panels; the open middle leaves the command and social areas visibly separate.
